ideas.title: Measure how often Israa's verdict matches the owner's decision
ideas.problem: Scripts now pass a gate of Israa (score >= 8) plus the Builder chat (script.min_score, script.builder_review). Both are Claude. Nothing records whether Israa's pass/rework agrees with what the owner then does. New research says judges can agree with each other and still disagree with humans (kappa 0.88 between two judges, 0.19 with humans; abstract at neurips.cc/virtual/2026/172889), and that raw percent agreement overstates quality by 33-41 points (arXiv 2606.19544). That was open-weight judges; the Claude judge in the same paper did better, so our gap may be small. We simply do not know.
ideas.proposal: Add a small read-only function in quality.py, e.g. judge_agreement(): for every episode that has data.review (Israa's verdict/score) and an owner decision (status approved/rejected after awaiting_approval, from decide_episode in agents.py, by='Owner'), build the 2x2 table Israa pass/rework vs owner approve/reject, and report percent agreement, Cohen's kappa, and the list of disagreements with the owner's note. Show it as one line in Atlas's `hq status` and in the Learning tab. No prompt change, no extra model call, no cost. If kappa is low after ~15 decided scripts, the next step (a separate idea) is to feed the owner's rejection notes into Israa's criteria.
ideas.gain: Turns 'Israa said 8' into a known quantity. Tells the owner whether the gate saves his 3 hours a week or only adds delay. Measured by: the number exists and updates after each owner decision.
ideas.test: Normal: 10 episodes with both fields give a table whose cells add to 10. Edge: an episode rejected by the owner after Israa's rework verdict, and an episode with no Israa review, must be skipped or counted separately, not crash. Failure case: all decisions the same (kappa undefined) must print 'not enough variety yet', not divide by zero. Pass = Atlas reports the agreement line and the three cases behave as described.
ideas.confidence_why: The method (chance-corrected agreement against human decisions) rests on two A-grade abstracts; I did not read the full papers and neither tests Claude as judge on stories, so the size of any gap for us is unknown.
ideas.risks: Few decided scripts so far, so early numbers are noisy: label it 'n = N'. Owner decisions also reflect taste, not only quality. No outside code, no licence issue.
